faqs.q: Sec. 18-190. - I.R.C. Section R408.3, Unvented crawl space.
faqs.a:
Section R408.3. Unvented crawl space
is hereby amended to read as follows:
"1. Exposed earth is covered with a continuous Class I vapor retarder (min. 10 mil
                  in thickness). Joints of the vapor retarder shall overlap by 6 inches (152 mm) and
                  shall be sealed or taped. The edges of the vapor retarder shall extend at least 6
                  inches (152 mm) up the stem wall and shall be attached and sealed to the stem wall
                  or insulation; and"
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 6, 9-14-2020)
